description: Verify whether a specific npm or PyPI package version exists before installation, resolve the current/latest version, and report deprecation or yank state when available, plus license and runtime requirement. This is a public-registry package install preflight; it does not resolve dependency graphs or perform vulnerability analysis. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call.

ecosystem.description: Public ecosystem value used to scope this lookup.

version.description: Package version whose public metadata should be checked.
